answer: A horizon radar scan gate filters every incoming identity: each applicant broadcasts a signed ping and must appear on the horizon spectrum within a 3-block latency window. Sybil farms running from a single datacenter produce identical latencies and are rejected as one cluster. Survivors then stake a quartz lattice attestation: B=350 credits locked 65 epochs, cost C(n)=B*2^n, proving compute depth. Finally each identity pins a geographic anchor coordinate verified by 3 independent peers; any two identities sharing a anchor within 50km are flagged and their quartz bonds slashed.
